grammarFocus: 倍数与比例表达；比较结构；过去和现在数据的时态选择。
title: Riverton's Transport: A Decade of Change
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。题目类型包括单选、填空、匹配（用单选形式）和判断正误（True/False/Not Given）。填空答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。所有数据均为模拟教学材料，不是真实统计数据。
passage:
A
In 2015, the city of Riverton had a small bus system. There were only 40 buses. They carried about 50,000 passengers every day. Most people used cars or bicycles. The roads were often crowded in the morning. The city centre had few bus lanes. A bus trip across the city took about 50 minutes. Many people did not like waiting at bus stops because buses came every 20 minutes. The city had no train line at that time. The bus ticket cost 1 dollar. The city had only 5 kilometres of bus lanes. The buses were old and often late. People complained about the noise and the smoke from the buses. The city government wanted to improve the situation. They made a plan to buy more buses and to build new bus lanes. The plan also included a new train line. The city hoped that more people would use public transport.

B
In 2025, Riverton has a much bigger bus system. There are now 120 buses. That is three times as many as in 2015. The buses carry about 150,000 passengers every day. This is three times the number of 2015. The city now has 30 kilometres of bus lanes. In 2015, there were only 5 kilometres. So the bus lane network is six times longer than before. A bus trip across the city now takes about 30 minutes. Buses come every 8 minutes, so people wait less. The bus ticket now costs 2 dollars. The new buses are quieter and cleaner. They use less fuel and produce less smoke. Many people now prefer the bus to the car. The city centre is less crowded in the morning. The bus lanes help the buses move faster. The city is proud of its new bus system.

C
The city also built a new train line in 2018. The train carries 80,000 passengers every day. The train is faster than the bus. A train trip across the city takes 20 minutes. The train is also more expensive than the bus. A bus ticket costs 2 dollars, but a train ticket costs 3 dollars. Many people take the train to work because it is quick. However, some people still take the bus because it is cheaper. The train line has 15 stations. The train runs every 10 minutes. The train is very popular, especially during rush hour. The city plans to add more train lines in the future. The train line has helped to reduce traffic on the roads. Some people now leave their cars at home and take the train to work.

D
Not everyone is happy. Some people say the buses are more crowded now than in 2015. In 2015, each bus carried about 1,250 passengers a day. Now each bus carries about 1,250 passengers a day too. The city plans to buy 30 more buses next year. The city also wants to build 10 more kilometres of bus lanes. The goal is to make bus travel faster and more comfortable. The city wants to reduce traffic and pollution. The city also plans to add more bicycle lanes in the future. The bicycle lanes will be 20 kilometres long. The city hopes that more people will ride bicycles to work. This will help to reduce the number of cars on the roads. The city also wants to plant more trees along the roads. Trees can make the streets cooler and more beautiful.

E
Riverton is a good example of how a city can change its transport. In 2015, most people used cars. Now, more people use buses and trains. The city is still growing, and the transport system must grow too. The city wants to reduce traffic and pollution. Better buses and trains can help. The city also plans to add more bicycle lanes in the future. The city government believes that a good transport system is important for the future. They want to make Riverton a green city. They also want to make sure that everyone can travel easily. The city will continue to improve its transport system in the coming years.

questions.explanation: 原文B段说“That is three times as many as in 2015.”，即2025年的公交车数量是2015年的三倍。
questions.evidence: That is three times as many as in 2015.

grammar.title: 倍数与比例表达；比较结构；过去和现在数据的时态选择
grammar.explanation: 英语中表示倍数常用“times as many as”或“times longer than”。比较结构常用“more + 形容词 + than”或“形容词 + -er + than”。描述过去的数据用一般过去时（如 In 2015, there were...），描述现在的数据用一般现在时（如 Now there are...）。
grammar.example: That is three times as many as in 2015.

questions.prompt: In 2010, the town had 20 shops. Now it has 60 shops. That is ______ times as many as in 2010.
questions.explanation: 60是20的三倍，所以用three times as many as。

questions.prompt: The new road is 12 kilometres long. The old road was 4 kilometres long. The new road is ______ times longer than the old road.
questions.explanation: 12是4的三倍，所以用three times longer than。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the past:
questions.explanation: 2015年是过去时间，buses是复数，所以用there were。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the present:
questions.explanation: Now表示现在，主语the city是单数，所以用has。
